item.title: Drupal vs TYPO3 vs Joomla vs Contao in 2026: Which Enterprise CMS Should You Self-Host?
item.description: WordPress powers a huge slice of the public web, but it is the wrong tool the moment you need structured content, granular editorial permissions across hundreds of editors, audit trails, or a multi-site tree with per-language governance. That is exactly the gap where four battle-hardened PHP systems still dominate government, university, and manufacturing sites in 2026: Drupal, TYPO3, Joomla, and Contao.
